headline: COL @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is COL 3.84 at ARI 5.03, with a projected total of 8.88. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (COL -0.16, ARI -0.21), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.38, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -8.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jose Quintana has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Corbin Carroll, Ketel Marte, TJ Rumfield, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adrian Del Castillo, Edouard Julien because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
